# Bulles en Valais — École & Cours de Plongée en Valais, Suisse

> Bulles en Valais is an independent scuba diving school based in Valais, Switzerland, founded and taught by Nicholas Jallan. The school provides personalized scuba diving courses, try-dives (baptêmes de plongée), recreational certifications (SDI, PADI, FFESSM/CMAS), specialties (drysuit, nitrox, deep diving) and advanced technical diving (TDI Trimix, rebreather). Courses are taught in French and English, in small groups (often one-to-one), primarily at Lac du Rosel (Martigny), Les Îles (Sion), and Lake Geneva (Léman).

## Quick Facts & Instructor Credentials

- **Founder & Instructor**: Nicholas Jallan
- **Certifications**:
  - SDI/TDI Instructor #100650 (Recreational & Technical Diving)
  - PADI Master Scuba Diver Trainer (MSDT) #444589
  - FFESSM / CMAS E4 Trimix Instructor #30806 (PTH120)
  - French State Diploma: DEJEPS #07425ED0350
- **Teaching Philosophy**: Private tuition or micro-groups (1 to 3 students max), tailored schedule, no rushed certification, focus on watermanship, ease, and real-world alpine lake diving skills.
- **Languages**: French (native), English (fluent).
- **Regions Served**: Canton du Valais (Martigny, Sion, Monthey, Saint-Maurice, Sierre), Canton de Vaud, Lake Geneva Riviera, Western Switzerland (Suisse romande).

## Courses & Pricing (CHF)

### Recreational Courses (SDI / PADI / FFESSM)
- **Try-dive / Baptême de plongée**: CHF 90 (approx. 2 hours, close supervision in open water)
- **Open Water Scuba Diver / OWD**: CHF 690 (SDI) / CHF 790 (PADI) — autonomous certification down to 18 m, worldwide recognition
- **Advanced Adventure / Advanced OWD**: CHF 450 (SDI) / CHF 550 (PADI) — depth to 30 m, navigation, night, deep
- **Rescue Diver**: CHF 890 (SDI) / CHF 990 (PADI) — safety, emergency management, self-rescue
- **Divemaster**: CHF 990 (SDI) / CHF 1090 (PADI) — first professional leadership level
- **FFESSM Federal Levels**:
  - Niveau 1 (PE20, supervised 20 m): CHF 390
  - Niveau 2 (autonomous 20 m, supervised 40 m): CHF 490
  - Niveau 3 (autonomous 60 m): CHF 690
  - Niveau 4 (guide de palanquée): CHF 990
- **Refresher / Remise à niveau (ReActivate)**: CHF 80 (~2h)
- **Discover Local Diving (guidage lac)**: CHF 80 (half-day)

### Technical & Specialty Courses (TDI / SDI / PADI)
- **TDI Nitrox (air enrichi jusqu'à 40%)**: CHF 290
- **TDI Advanced Nitrox (mélanges jusqu'à 100%)**: CHF 290
- **TDI Decompression Procedures**: CHF 250
- **Drysuit Diver (Combinaison étanche)**: CHF 250 (SDI) / CHF 300 (PADI) — essential for cold alpine lakes
- **Deep Diver (Plongée profonde 40 m)**: CHF 290 (SDI) / CHF 340 (PADI)
- **Trimix & CCR Rebreather (Recycleur)**: On request / Sur demande (custom coaching up to 120 m)

## Dive Sites

1. **Lac du Rosel (Martigny, Valais)**: max depth 23 m, exceptionally clear water, calm mountain quarry lake, ideal for try-dives and initial open water training.
2. **Les Îles (Sion, Valais)**: max depth 38 m, year-round predictable conditions, training platforms, navigation drills.
3. **Lake Geneva / Lac Léman (Rivaz, Hermance, Chillon Castle, Tougues)**: max depth up to 300 m, spectacular drop-offs (parois rocheuses), historic wrecks (l'Hirondelle), deep and technical dives.

## Gift Vouchers (Bons Cadeaux)

- Gift vouchers available for try-dives (baptêmes), certification courses or custom amounts.
- Valid for 1 year, delivered by PDF, dates arranged directly with the instructor.
